title: Recover closure when a recorded legacy branch identity differs from its Work Item ID
outOfScope: Provider configuration, branch-protection settings, release publication, and distribution operations.
Changing immutable archived evidence for release-profile-documentation-closure.

Immutable archived Work Item being closed.

riskAssessment.reason: The change affects fail-closed branch and PR identity verification.

reasons: Lifecycle cleanup and branch deletion are protected governance operations.

preReviewWarnings: Preserve the default exact branch identity check; accept a legacy identity only when it is recorded by the archived Work Item start receipt and matches the merged PR.

acceptance: Normal Work Items still require branch codex/<workItemId> during closure.
A legacy branch identity is accepted only when the archived Work Item start receipt records it and the merged PR head branch and SHA match it.
An unrecorded or mismatched branch remains rejected, and focused tests cover both acceptance and rejection.
The blocked release-profile-documentation-closure lifecycle completes using the compatibility path without rewriting its archive.
guidelines: Keep closure fail-closed: compatibility must be evidence-bound and narrower than the default path.
Do not rewrite immutable archived Work Item records.
Add focused tests for both allowed and denied compatibility paths.

intent.problem: A completed Work Item cannot close because its historical work branch was abbreviated while the closure command derives only codex/<workItemId>.
constraints: Do not weaken PR, SHA, clean-worktree, base synchronization, or branch-deletion verification.
Do not edit the blocked Work Item archive.
intent.rationale: A bounded start-receipt identity adapter preserves fail-closed verification while allowing recovery from the exact historical branch mismatch.

scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run focused closure tests for the existing canonical branch path.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Recorded legacy branch identity closes only when it matches the merged PR identity.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add and run a focused test with a matching archived start receipt and merged PR.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Unrecorded or mismatched identity remains blocked.
scenarioCoverage.expected: No arbitrary merged branch can be closed for a task.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add and run focused rejection tests for an absent or nonmatching start-receipt identity.
